versions.changelog:
Initial release of Agentic AI Ring Designer, enabling comprehensive ring and jewelry design workflows.

- Generate hand-drawn design sheets, multiview sketches, and interactive 3D ring models from text and image prompts.
- Customize rings, bracelets, necklaces, earrings, body chains, and pet collars with gemstone types, metals, shapes, and materials.
- Leverages OneKey Agent Gateway API (DEEPNLP_ONEKEY_ROUTER_ACCESS required).
- Supports luxury jewelry categories and personalized design parameters.
- Provides access to online designer apps, 3D model viewers, and manufacturing-on-demand workflow.
